annotationRationale: Returning after a whole number of laps becomes a divisibility condition. Enumerating the eligible divisors finds the earliest qualifying time.
sourceMethod: Followed the official enumeration of divisor counts for times 1 through 12, explaining why only integer times need checking.

review.mathCheck: A return requires t/k to be an integer, so only integer times need checking. The divisor counts through 11 are all below five; at 12, exactly Horses 1, 2, 3, 4, and 6 return. Thus T=12 and its digit sum is 3, choice B.
